283547786.description:
Decorative Collectibles Lot - 3 Pieces
Porcelain Cat Head Pipe & Miniature Dutch Shoes
This three-piece collection features a decorative novelty pipe and a pair of miniature ceramic Dutch clog shoes. The pipe showcases an Asian zoomorphic design with a blue and white porcelain cat head bowl and a brass stem adorned with applied wire detailing. Accompanied by two Delft-style porcelain clogs painted with traditional windmills, this set appeals to collectors of feline memorabilia, tobacciana, and novelty miniatures.
Items Included:
Porcelain & brass pipe - Blue and white cat head bowl, brass stem with filigree trim, ~5.5 inches long
Miniature Dutch clog (piece 1) - White ceramic with blue windmill motif, ~0.75 inches long
Miniature Dutch clog (piece 2) - White ceramic with blue windmill motif, ~0.75 inches long
Condition:
Porcelain cat head bowl exhibits fine glaze crazing and surface wear. Brass stem shows age patina, minor tarnish, and exposed end threads. Ceramic shoes have minor shelf wear with no large chips or breaks.

283356871.description:
Natural Tumbled Stone Collection
Polished Mineral and Gemstone Specimen Lot
5 Pieces, Total Weight 56.7 Grams
This five-piece collection features an assortment of smooth, tumbled mineral and gemstone specimens showcasing distinct colors, banding, and textural patterns. Ideal for crystal collections, decorative display, pocket stones, or lapidary study, each piece has been tumbled and polished to a glossy finish accentuating its natural geological features.
Items Included:
One orange webbed/banded agate tumbled stone
One deep reddish-brown polished jasper specimen
One sparkling copper-tone goldstone tumbled piece
One banded polychrome/desert jasper stone with earth tones
One mottled grey, green, and pink natural mineral stone
Condition:
All five specimens are in clean condition with smooth tumble-polished surfaces and rounded contours. As with all tumbled natural stones, minor inherent surface pits, natural micro-crevices, and geological variations are present. No severe post-polish fractures or damage observed.
